I am a new customer to AAA and i just had to leave a rating even though i usually never do.
I cannot express how impressed i am with the quality of service i received. …

Me and my dad came in last weekend for a repair on my Tahoe passenger light. Even though they didn't have the light Matt went above and beyond  with researching the best reasonable prices we were able to get it installed this week  they …

Paid over $400 for a delivery boy. They explained when I called that the technician would change the tire on site for my wife. Instead of doing that he loaded up her wheel in his GMC suv (not a work van like I was led to believe) and left her to take it to “a shop they trust” to change the tire. I have no idea who actually installed that tire or where they took it. We checked the lug nuts after the “technician” left and found one loose. Take everything they say with a grain of salt because when you call them on their BS they might just call you a liar. I would not have agreed to service if I knew that all I paid for was for some guy to pick up the wheel and take it somewhere else. It’s not poor communication, it’s deceptive. And it’s definitely not what I agreed to. Not even an itemized receipt so I have absolutely no clue what the hell I just paid for. I tried reaching out to their customer service email for an itemized receipt and the results are pictured here.

Needed a tire change ASAP and Supreme Mobile Tire came through fast. Mykal showed up on time, handled everything professionally, and made the whole process smooth with zero hassle. You can tell they know what they’re doing and take pride in …

Best service ever!  Mykal responded right away, kept me updated on ETA and arrived quickly. And everything was done just a few minutes. Definitely recommend using this company for ease and convenience.  So with it!

I got a lift and 35's put on my dodge 1500 here near the end of last year 2024. It looked good but drove like crap. I took it back up there 2 weeks later asking if they could do anything about it. The guys just took the front tires off and rebalanced them and said good to go. I finally had enough of it and took my truck to another lift shop. They said whoever installed the lift didn't know what they were doing. Adjustment bolts in the wrong spots and backwards. Wheel weights all over like they struggled to balancing the tires. I didn't even want to take it back up there to have them correct it all. Decided to shell out another 1300$ to a more reputable business to have it done the right way like I should have done in the first place.

Besides the poor mechanical skills of installing the lift and tires properly. They were friendly, but I don't recommend using them. This was a big set back for me financially and i also went months without being able to  drive my personal truck.

Good customer service. High priced Tires. But I had to get it cause my tire wouldn't have made it anywhere else. $120 for a new tire that costs $60 at Walmart, what a rip off. But like I said, if you have no choice, what can you do.
Joe and Pollo was such a big help! They helped us so much today it was wonderful. I usually go to the one beside it but they earned me as a loyal customer today,

I pulled in after getting a flat and they assisted me right away. They had other customers and all were being attended. Amazing staff! They were able to get me out and on my way in minimal time . Great prices too ! Would definitely recommend.

Scammed. Sold me a part that was supposedly required, and when I took it to another guy, the part wasn't even plugged in. Scammed. I'm sure I'm going to get a reply from the business that refutes this, but I'm telling you what it is.

I went in to get some speakers installed in my car (2 in the front 2 in the back ) they said they charge 130 for just installing speakers I already had . 2nd of all I asked for tint options and also over priced, so I ended up taking my business else where.
There's a lot of other great stores that have much better prices.
Don't get me wrong the store is nice and the staff as well but prices are over priced in my opinion .

Visited this afternoon.... waited at least 10 to 15 minutes never could get waited on so I left. I was the only person there, the associate was on the phone the entire time. To me a person who comes in to speak and ask for help should be just as important as the caller. Try hiring some help!!!
I went elsewhere and got waited on as soon as I walked in. My questions were answered and the work was done on my car in less than 30 minutes. Now that is customer service!!

I have been coming here for 5+ years. I have gotten alarms, tint, led lights & radios done here on numerous cars.. I normally deal with junior, but i got a new car & wanted  tint so i called & got a quote on Saturday aug 6th.i guess it was my fault for not getting a name, bcz when i got there. It was two younger guys i haven't  seen before the one guy gave me a different  quote i explained i called both guys looked @ each other like ohh well thats what it is... I told them one of guys had to give me the quote but they didn't care.. Long story short.. I will pay what they told me to their competitor with no problem.. Word of mouth carries alot of weight...treat your faithful customers fair

My standards were simply not met when I asked to get the alarm fixed. If they could not fix it themselves, they should have let me know so I could find someone who can.. Instead got charged for something I did not need, nor asked for.

Great service! The workers are very polite and helpful! Great prices and quality work! Definitely recommend this shop for any car services or repairs! Thanks for your help and services! I will be recommending everyone to you guys!

Don't waste your time driving out here. They lie to you and tell you things that aren't true. Complete waste of time. They also send pictures of things that they don't have, once you get there it's a different color and on a completely different vehicle.

I drove 3 hours to buy rims they posted on Facebook. bought them and got them home just to find out they tried welding three of them and they were leaking air. Tried calling the boss there and he didn’t help at all and instead just hung up on me. I do not recommend this place.
Beware!! They sell broken or bent parts. Bought an axle came home and saw it was bent on the control arm housing. I told about it and needed for exchange but never replied me.

How is it okay to let your drivers drive around without their proper paperwork?? When ask to provide a drivers license, TDLR license, cab card and insurance your driver couldn’t provide anything. He stated “I work with the dealership”... um excuse me if you drive a tow truck by law those documents and licenses have to be with you at all times. Do your drivers even have a TDLR???
Good place to get inexpensive used parts
This commercial business is in a neighborhood and the big trucks ruin our roads

Go to Pedro’s Tire shop down the street not here!! they are way nicer!! I came to this place for the first time without my husband, and I asked for a patch or plug just to get me a few miles away to get a new tire where I have warranty. They said it couldn’t be done because of the position of the nail so I just asked them to put air in the one tire just to get to drop off my son at school and they did but still charged me $10, even though the sign said $2 for air pressure and my husband has gone multiple times for just air and they don’t even charge him. It was not about the money but the way they acted was so off and rude! Thankfully Pedro’s did it all with no problem and were even nice enough to fill all my tires with air!

Got a flat yesterday and had to use this tire shop to patch up my tire. This morning I decided to wash my car and noticed that they scratched my wheel up really bad. They chipped off a big piece of paint and scratched the wheel all over. Wouldn’t recommend going here at all. Took over 30 minutes to patch the tire as well.

I retract my first review , I stand corrected Texas Tire on Bonnview has great service if you have a issue please let the technician know your issues and they will correct it . I recommend these guys to anyone needing repairs done . 👌 …
